text:
violet: Trying to cut the JS SDK for sampleapp but publish is blocked by regendiff. It reports a minor bump because generated example objects changed key order only.

dan: ouch. paste the tiny diff?

violet: snippet:```diff
- examples:
-  - value: {
-      "role": "user",
-      "text": "hi"
-    }
+ examples:
+  - value: {
+      "text": "hi",
+      "role": "user"
+    }
```No API surface change. This is churn from typegen v0.14 using stable-serialize alphabetical keys.

sarah: we've seen this pattern. regendiff currently treats any generated-file diff as semver-impacting. Two options: manual override in release UI, or make regendiff canonicalize example values before diffing.

matt: I'd prefer canonicalize + an opt-in marker like `// regendiff: examples-canonicalize` so we don't accidentally ignore real changes.

regendiff-bot: Automated: regen diff detected in packages/sdk-js/src/generated/chat_examples.ts. Classified: examples-only. Semver-lens: candidate minor bump.

ci-bot: CI: publish pipeline #512 failed at regendiff gate. Log: `semver-check: candidate minor bump detected`.

violet: I'll open a tiny dev-tools PR that canonicalizes `examples` object values using json-pointer so nested maps/arrays are handled, and supports `// regendiff:` opt-in. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/pull/512 (draft).

dan: For immediate unblock, release-ops can approve an override if PR link + short rationale present.

release-ops: I can do one-off override. Please include brief justification in the release UI.

violet: Done — override requested and PR opened. Also adding a note in release playbook: "example-object key-order changes are ignored when generator-stable-serialize is used; prefer regendiff canonicalization over manual overrides."

regendiff-bot: New commits applied from PR 512. Re-running regendiff...

ci-bot: CI: publish pipeline #513 re-run passed regendiff step. No semver bump detected.

violet: Publishing now (`yarn lerna publish from-package --yes`). Follow-ups: (1) land canonicalizer across other SDK generators, (2) add small unit tests to dev-tools for nested example maps, (3) update release docs and communicate to SDK owners.

sarah: also track in backlog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/issues/200 - audit generator churn and harmonize stringify behavior.

violet: Publish completed. Thanks team! :rocket:
